mapper.sql: select l.*, u.nick_name as owner_name, d.dept_name from biz_lead l left join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.owner_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = l.dept_id

sql.if: and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' where ur.user_id = #{currentUserId} and ( r.data_scope = '1' or (r.data_scope = '2' and l.dept_id in (select rd.dept_id from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id = r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope = '3' and l.dept_id = #{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope = '4' and l.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id = #{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope = '5' and l.owner_id = #{currentUserId}) ) )

and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role role_scope on role_scope.role_id=ur.role_id and role_scope.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( role_scope.data_scope='1' or (role_scope.data_scope='2' and l.dept_id in ( select rd.dept_id from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id=role_scope.role_id)) or (role_scope.data_scope='3' and l.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (role_scope.data_scope='4' and l.dept_id in ( select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId},sd.ancestors))) or (role_scope.data_scope='5' and l.owner_id=#{currentUserId}) ) )

mapper.sql: t.todo_id,t.title todo_title,t.status todo_status,t.owner_id todo_owner_id, todo_owner.nick_name todo_owner_name,t.due_at,t.sla_status, case when t.sla_status in ('OVERDUE','ESCALATED') or (t.status not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') and t.due_at<sysdate()) then true else false end overdue, case when t.sla_status='ESCALATED' or sla.escalate150_at is not null then true else false end escalated, sla.escalate150_at escalated_at
mapper.insert: insert into biz_lead ( lead_no, lead_name, contact_name, mobile, wechat, company_name, source_code, status, pool_status, disposition, priority, legal_demand, estimated_amount, owner_id, dept_id, next_follow_time, remark, create_by, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{leadNo}, #{leadName}, #{contactName}, #{mobile}, #{wechat}, #{companyName}, #{sourceCode}, #{status}, #{poolStatus}, case when #{poolStatus}='1' then 'PUBLIC_POOL' else 'ACTIVE' end, #{priority}, #{legalDemand}, #{estimatedAmount}, #{ownerId}, #{deptId}, #{nextFollowTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.delete: delete from biz_lead where del_flag = '2' and lead_id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_lead_assignment_log(lead_id, from_owner_id, to_owner_id, action_type, reason, create_by, create_time) values(#{leadId}, #{fromOwnerId}, #{toOwnerId}, #{actionType}, #{reason}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select followup_id as followupId, lead_id as leadId, follow_type as followType, follow_result as followResult, content, next_follow_time as nextFollowTime, follow_user_id as followUserId, task_status as taskStatus, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime from biz_lead_followup where followup_id = #{followupId}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_lead_followup(lead_id, follow_type, follow_result, content, next_follow_time, follow_user_id, task_status, create_by, create_time) values(#{leadId}, #{followType}, #{followResult}, #{content}, #{nextFollowTime}, #{followUserId}, '1', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from biz_lead_followup where followup_id = #{followupId} and lead_id = #{leadId}
mapper.update: update biz_lead set last_follow_time=sysdate(), next_follow_time=#{nextFollowTime}, status=case when status in ('0','1') then '2' else status end, row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where lead_id=#{leadId} and del_flag='0' and pool_status='0' and owner_id is not null and status in ('1','2') and row_version=#{expectedRowVersion}

update biz_lead set last_follow_time=sysdate(), next_follow_time=#{nextFollowTime}, status='2', row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where lead_id=#{leadId} and del_flag='0' and pool_status='0' and owner_id is not null and status=#{expectedStatus} and row_version=#{expectedRowVersion}

update biz_lead set first_contact_status='COMPLETED', first_contact_time=sysdate(), first_contact_result=#{result}, contact_name=case when #{result}='VALID' then #{contactName} else contact_name end, city=case when #{result}='VALID' then #{city} else city end, legal_demand=case when #{result}='VALID' then #{legalDemand} else legal_demand end, visited=case when #{result}='VALID' then #{visited} else visited end, invalid_reason_code=case when #{result}='SUSPECT_INVALID' then #{invalidReasonCode} else invalid_reason_code end, invalid_source_node=case when #{result}='SUSPECT_INVALID' then #{invalidSourceNode} else invalid_source_node end, invalid_review_status=case when #{result}='SUSPECT_INVALID' then 'PENDING' else invalid_review_status end, retry_stage=case when #{result}='UNREACHABLE' then 'T0' else retry_stage end, retry_attempt_count=case when #{result}='UNREACHABLE' then 0 else retry_attempt_count end, row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where lead_id=#{leadId} and del_flag='0' and disposition='ACTIVE' and status=#{expectedStatus} and (first_contact_status is null or first_contact_status='PENDING') and row_version=#{rowVersion}

update biz_lead set invalid_review_status=case when #{reviewResult}='TRUE_INVALID' then 'CONFIRMED' else 'MISJUDGED' end, row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where lead_id=#{leadId} and del_flag='0' and disposition='ACTIVE' and invalid_review_status=#{expectedReviewStatus} and row_version=#{rowVersion}

update biz_lead set retry_stage=#{nextStage}, retry_attempt_count=#{attemptCount}, next_retry_time=#{nextRetryTime}, row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where lead_id=#{leadId} and del_flag='0' and disposition='ACTIVE' and ((#{expectedStage} is null and retry_stage is null) or retry_stage=#{expectedStage}) and row_version=#{rowVersion}

update biz_lead set disposition='DEAD_POOL', status='4', pool_status='0', owner_id=null, dept_id=null, dead_pool_time=sysdate(), dead_pool_reason=#{reason}, next_retry_time=null, row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where lead_id=#{leadId} and del_flag='0' and disposition='ACTIVE' and invalid_review_status='CONFIRMED' and row_version=#{rowVersion}

update biz_lead set disposition='PUBLIC_POOL', status='0', pool_status='1', owner_id=null, dept_id=null, pool_reason=#{reason}, dead_pool_time=null, dead_pool_reason=null, first_contact_status=null, first_contact_time=null, first_contact_result=null, invalid_reason_code=null, invalid_source_node=null, invalid_review_status=null, retry_stage=null, retry_attempt_count=0, next_retry_time=null, row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where lead_id=#{leadId} and del_flag='0' and disposition='DEAD_POOL' and row_version=#{rowVersion}

update biz_lead set first_contact_status='PENDING', row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where lead_id=#{leadId} and del_flag='0' and disposition='ACTIVE' and invalid_review_status='MISJUDGED' and row_version=#{rowVersion}

update biz_lead set first_contact_status='COMPLETED', first_contact_time=sysdate(), first_contact_result='VALID', contact_name=#{contactName}, city=#{city}, legal_demand=#{legalDemand}, visited=#{visited}, retry_stage=null, retry_attempt_count=0, next_retry_time=null, row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where lead_id=#{leadId} and del_flag='0' and disposition='ACTIVE' and first_contact_result='UNREACHABLE' and retry_stage=#{expectedStage} and row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.select:
select count(1) from biz_lead l where l.lead_id = #{leadId} and l.del_flag = '0' and l.del_flag in ('0','2')
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' where ur.user_id = #{currentUserId} and ( r.data_scope = '1' or (r.data_scope = '2' and l.dept_id in (select rd.dept_id from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id = r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope = '3' and l.dept_id = #{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope = '4' and l.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id = #{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope = '5' and l.owner_id = #{currentUserId}) ) )

select setting_id as settingId, setting_type as settingType, setting_code as settingCode, setting_name as settingName, color, order_num as orderNum, status, remark from biz_lead_setting and setting_type=#{settingType} order by setting_type, order_num, setting_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_lead_setting(setting_type, setting_code, setting_name, color, order_num, status, remark, create_by, create_time) values(#{settingType}, #{settingCode}, #{settingName}, #{color}, #{orderNum}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select 'total' metricKey, count(*) metricValue from biz_lead l where del_flag='0' union all select 'mine', count(*) from biz_lead l where del_flag='0' and owner_id=#{currentUserId} union all select 'pool', count(*) from biz_lead l where del_flag='0' and pool_status='1' union all select 'followToday', count(*) from biz_lead l where del_flag='0' and date(next_follow_time) <= curdate() and status not in ('3','4','5')

select coalesce(s.setting_name, l.source_code, '未设置') itemName, count(*) itemValue from biz_lead l left join biz_lead_setting s on s.setting_type='source' and s.setting_code=l.source_code where l.del_flag='0' group by coalesce(s.setting_name, l.source_code, '未设置') order by itemValue desc
select status itemName, count(*) itemValue from biz_lead l where del_flag='0' group by status order by status

select l.lead_id,l.lead_no,l.lead_name,l.mobile,l.source_code,l.disposition, l.owner_id business_owner_id,business_owner.nick_name business_owner_name, l.dept_id business_dept_id,business_dept.dept_name business_dept_name, call_fact.call_record_id,call_fact.call_channel,call_fact.external_call_id, call_fact.duration_seconds,call_fact.recording_file_object_id, call_fact.call_result result,call_fact.started_at fact_time,
from biz_lead_call_record call_fact join biz_lead l on l.lead_id=call_fact.lead_id and l.del_flag='0' left join sys_user business_owner on business_owner.user_id=l.owner_id left join sys_dept business_dept on business_dept.dept_id=l.dept_id left join todo_instance t on t.todo_id=call_fact.todo_id left join sys_user todo_owner on todo_owner.user_id=t.owner_id left join todo_sla_record sla on sla.todo_id=t.todo_id where call_fact.lead_id=#{leadId} order by call_fact.started_at desc,call_fact.call_record_id desc

select l.lead_id,l.lead_no,l.lead_name,l.mobile,l.source_code,l.disposition, l.owner_id business_owner_id,business_owner.nick_name business_owner_name, l.dept_id business_dept_id,business_dept.dept_name business_dept_name, review.review_id,review.status fact_status,review.review_result result, review.reason_code,review.sales_explanation detail,review.reviewer_id, reviewer.nick_name reviewer_name,review.submitted_at fact_time,
from biz_lead_invalid_review review join biz_lead l on l.lead_id=review.lead_id and l.del_flag='0' left join sys_user origin_user on origin_user.user_id=review.submitted_by left join sys_user business_owner on business_owner.user_id=coalesce(l.owner_id,review.submitted_by) left join sys_dept business_dept on business_dept.dept_id=coalesce(l.dept_id,origin_user.dept_id) left join sys_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id=review.reviewer_id left join todo_instance t on t.todo_id=( select max(candidate.todo_id) from todo_instance candidate where candidate.business_type='LEAD' and candidate.business_id=review.lead_id and candidate.template_code='TD-002' and candidate.previous_todo_id=review.todo_id) left join sys_user todo_owner on todo_owner.user_id=t.owner_id left join todo_sla_record sla on sla.todo_id=t.todo_id
and review.status=#{status}
and (l.lead_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or l.lead_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or l.mobile like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
and (review.reviewer_id=#{currentUserId} or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role role_scope on role_scope.role_id=ur.role_id and role_scope.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( role_scope.data_scope='1' or (role_scope.data_scope='2' and origin_user.dept_id in ( select rd.dept_id from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id=role_scope.role_id)) or (role_scope.data_scope='3' and origin_user.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (role_scope.data_scope='4' and origin_user.dept_id in ( select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId},sd.ancestors))) or (role_scope.data_scope='5' and review.submitted_by=#{currentUserId}) ) ))
order by case when review.status='PENDING' then 0 else 1 end, coalesce(t.due_at,review.submitted_at),review.review_id

select l.lead_id,l.lead_no,l.lead_name,l.mobile,l.source_code,l.disposition, l.owner_id business_owner_id,business_owner.nick_name business_owner_name, l.dept_id business_dept_id,business_dept.dept_name business_dept_name, plan.plan_id,window_item.window_id,occurrence.occurrence_id,occurrence.occurrence_no, window_item.window_code,coalesce(occurrence.status,window_item.status) fact_status, occurrence.result_code result,occurrence.create_time fact_time, window_item.materialize_at window_start_at,window_item.due_at window_due_at,
from todo_schedule_plan plan join biz_lead l on l.lead_id=plan.business_id and plan.business_type='LEAD' and l.del_flag='0' join todo_schedule_window window_item on window_item.plan_id=plan.plan_id left join todo_schedule_occurrence occurrence on occurrence.window_id=window_item.window_id left join todo_instance t on t.todo_id=occurrence.todo_id left join sys_user business_owner on business_owner.user_id=l.owner_id left join sys_dept business_dept on business_dept.dept_id=l.dept_id left join sys_user todo_owner on todo_owner.user_id=t.owner_id left join todo_sla_record sla on sla.todo_id=t.todo_id
and coalesce(occurrence.status,window_item.status,plan.status)=#{status}
and (l.lead_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or l.lead_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or l.mobile like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by window_item.materialize_at,window_item.window_order,occurrence.occurrence_no

select l.lead_id,l.lead_no,l.lead_name,l.mobile,l.source_code,l.disposition, l.owner_id business_owner_id,business_owner.nick_name business_owner_name, l.dept_id business_dept_id,business_dept.dept_name business_dept_name, retry_fact.retry_record_id,retry_fact.attempt_no,retry_fact.contact_result result, retry_fact.next_window_code,retry_fact.occurred_at fact_time, plan.plan_id,window_item.window_id,occurrence.occurrence_id,occurrence.occurrence_no, window_item.window_code,coalesce(occurrence.status,window_item.status) fact_status, window_item.materialize_at window_start_at,window_item.due_at window_due_at,
from todo_schedule_plan plan join biz_lead l on l.lead_id=plan.business_id and plan.business_type='LEAD' and l.del_flag='0' join todo_schedule_window window_item on window_item.plan_id=plan.plan_id left join todo_schedule_occurrence occurrence on occurrence.window_id=window_item.window_id left join todo_instance t on t.todo_id=occurrence.todo_id left join biz_lead_retry_record retry_fact on retry_fact.todo_id=t.todo_id left join sys_user business_owner on business_owner.user_id=l.owner_id left join sys_dept business_dept on business_dept.dept_id=l.dept_id left join sys_user todo_owner on todo_owner.user_id=t.owner_id left join todo_sla_record sla on sla.todo_id=t.todo_id where l.lead_id=#{leadId} order by plan.plan_id,window_item.window_order,occurrence.occurrence_no, retry_fact.attempt_no,retry_fact.retry_record_id

select l.lead_id,l.lead_no,l.lead_name,l.mobile,l.source_code,l.disposition, review.submitted_by business_owner_id,origin_user.nick_name business_owner_name, origin_user.dept_id business_dept_id,origin_dept.dept_name business_dept_name, dead_log.dead_pool_log_id,dead_log.reason_code,dead_log.reason_detail detail, dead_log.action_type fact_status,dead_log.action_time fact_time, review.review_id,review.reviewer_id,reviewer.nick_name reviewer_name,
from biz_lead l join biz_lead_dead_pool_log dead_log on dead_log.dead_pool_log_id=( select max(latest.dead_pool_log_id) from biz_lead_dead_pool_log latest where latest.lead_id=l.lead_id and latest.action_type='ENTER') join biz_lead_invalid_review review on review.review_id=( select max(latest_review.review_id) from biz_lead_invalid_review latest_review where latest_review.lead_id=l.lead_id and latest_review.review_result='TRUE_INVALID') left join sys_user origin_user on origin_user.user_id=review.submitted_by left join sys_dept origin_dept on origin_dept.dept_id=origin_user.dept_id left join sys_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id=review.reviewer_id left join todo_instance t on t.todo_id=( select max(candidate.todo_id) from todo_instance candidate where candidate.business_type='LEAD' and candidate.business_id=l.lead_id and candidate.template_code='TD-002' and candidate.previous_todo_id=review.todo_id) left join sys_user todo_owner on todo_owner.user_id=t.owner_id left join todo_sla_record sla on sla.todo_id=t.todo_id where l.del_flag='0' and l.disposition='DEAD_POOL' and dead_log.reason_code=#{reasonCode}
and (l.lead_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or l.lead_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or l.mobile like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role role_scope on role_scope.role_id=ur.role_id and role_scope.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( role_scope.data_scope='1' or (role_scope.data_scope='2' and origin_user.dept_id in ( select rd.dept_id from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id=role_scope.role_id)) or (role_scope.data_scope='3' and origin_user.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (role_scope.data_scope='4' and origin_user.dept_id in ( select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId},sd.ancestors))) or (role_scope.data_scope='5' and review.submitted_by=#{currentUserId}) ) )
order by dead_log.action_time desc,dead_log.dead_pool_log_id desc

select l.*,business_owner.nick_name owner_name,business_dept.dept_name from biz_lead l join biz_lead_invalid_review review on review.review_id=( select max(latest_review.review_id) from biz_lead_invalid_review latest_review where latest_review.lead_id=l.lead_id and latest_review.review_result='TRUE_INVALID') join biz_lead_dead_pool_log dead_log on dead_log.dead_pool_log_id=( select max(latest_log.dead_pool_log_id) from biz_lead_dead_pool_log latest_log where latest_log.lead_id=l.lead_id and latest_log.action_type='ENTER') left join sys_user business_owner on business_owner.user_id=l.owner_id left join sys_dept business_dept on business_dept.dept_id=l.dept_id where l.lead_id=#{leadId} and l.del_flag='0' for update

select count(*) from biz_lead l join biz_lead_invalid_review review on review.review_id=( select max(latest_review.review_id) from biz_lead_invalid_review latest_review where latest_review.lead_id=l.lead_id and latest_review.review_result='TRUE_INVALID') join sys_user origin_user on origin_user.user_id=review.submitted_by join biz_lead_dead_pool_log dead_log on dead_log.dead_pool_log_id=( select max(latest_log.dead_pool_log_id) from biz_lead_dead_pool_log latest_log where latest_log.lead_id=l.lead_id and latest_log.action_type='ENTER') where l.lead_id=#{leadId} and l.del_flag='0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role role_scope on role_scope.role_id=ur.role_id and role_scope.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( role_scope.data_scope='1' or (role_scope.data_scope='2' and origin_user.dept_id in ( select rd.dept_id from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id=role_scope.role_id)) or (role_scope.data_scope='3' and origin_user.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (role_scope.data_scope='4' and origin_user.dept_id in ( select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId},sd.ancestors))) or (role_scope.data_scope='5' and review.submitted_by=#{currentUserId}) ) )

select count(*) from sys_dept target where target.dept_id=#{deptId} and target.status='0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role role_scope on role_scope.role_id=ur.role_id and role_scope.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( role_scope.data_scope='1' or (role_scope.data_scope='2' and target.dept_id in ( select rd.dept_id from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id=role_scope.role_id)) or (role_scope.data_scope='3' and target.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (role_scope.data_scope='4' and ( target.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId},target.ancestors))) ) )
